visualCharacteristics.purpose: Sprinklr social (Instagram) gallery; the Sprinklr script is loaded lazily only when the block is scrolled near the viewport. A placeholder reserves space until posts render; if the script cannot run (CSP, network, timeout) the block collapses and the section's default-content Follow link remains the fallback
visualCharacteristics.description: Light warm grey background rgb(246,245,243), 48px/80px padding. Header row: H3 left, text link with arrow right (Instagram). Below: Sprinklr packery-tile social gallery (63 posts, 2 rows of images) with a green "Load more" pill.

contentPattern.structure: One cell: link to the Sprinklr embed script (https://gallery.sprinklr.com/clients/CLIENT_ID/embeds/EMBED_ID/script.js). A bare embed id is also accepted and uses client 24392. Gallery posts are rendered by Sprinklr at runtime
contentPattern.description: Sprinklr social gallery embed (https://gallery.sprinklr.com/clients/24392/embeds/ZW1iZWQ6NjYwYTg5MTU2NGZiMGI1NTEzMzI4OGEw/script.js) | Script-driven Sprinklr packery tile gallery of Instagram posts with Load more button, not a URL/iframe embed

usage: Use for the social gallery band; put the heading and Instagram link in default content above it.
reuseGuidance: For other third-party scripts create a dedicated embed variant.
